verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs explicitly state disk auto-grows with usage up to 100GB per Sprite and billing is only for bytes actually written, matching the story precisely, and general pay-as-you-go storage pricing is reiterated elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of this billing behavior, clarity on whether it applies to standard Fly Volumes beyond the newer 'Sprites' product, and confirmation of no minimum/rounding charges.
